title: Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

reports.title: Parkview High receives 4th AI-generated bomb threat this year
Hoax phone call at Gwinnett high school causes lockdown; campus cleared
Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

summary:
Parkview High School in Gwinnett County, Georgia received its fourth AI-generated bomb threat of the school year on Monday. School officials placed the campus on lockdown as a precaution, and it later returned to normal operations. The latest threat followed a pattern seen in recent incidents, involving the use of a masked phone number.

Gwinnett County Public Schools police are now working with the Georgia Bureau of Investigation and the FBI to determine who is responsible for the threats. No arrests have been made and no suspect has been identified in connection with the incidents. The school police described the pattern in a letter to parents. The investigation is ongoing, but authorities have not announced any further steps or a timeline for resolving the case.
